name.value: Haida Heritage Centre at Kay Llnagaay

description.value: The Haida Heritage Centre at Ḵay Llnagaay is an award-winning Indigenous cultural attraction on Haida Gwaii, designed to resemble a traditional oceanside Haida village and spanning 50,000 square feet of museum, performance, carving, and canoe spaces. It sits at the ancient village site of 'Sea-Lion Town' and houses the Haida Gwaii Museum alongside a bistro, teaching centre, and rotating cultural programming. Located just a 10-minute walk from the Skidegate ferry landing, it is a natural first stop for cyclists arriving on the island by BC Ferries.
